note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: dated customs/B-L records with HS codes, destinations and BOL numbers, latest 2026-02-27, so the company is an active exporter of builders hardware (brass/aluminium door and cabinet handles, spindles). Declared HS set 741810/741820/741999/830140 does not match the observed shipment codes 83024110, 76161000, 73269099, 83024110 — per project rule 3 this is NOT a rejection ground; the actual codes should be recorded as 83024110 (builders hardware, base metal), 76161000 (aluminium articles) and 73269099 (other iron/steel articles), with 830140 appearing only in the separate Nepal-buyer record. Important disambiguation: the slug 'ace-hardware-pvt-ltd' on ImportKey is a DIFFERENT entity — 'ACE HARDWARE PVT LTD, Kathmandu, NEPAL', 34 shipments, buyer only, supplied by LINK LOCKS PRIVATE LIMITED (e.g. '2026-01-30 | LINK LOCKS PRIVATE LIMITED -> ACE HARDWARE PVT LTD | WI-FI SMART DOOR LOCK | RAXAUL INRXLB -> Kathmandu, NEPAL | 83014090 | BOL 9204659'); likewise slug 'ace-hardware' is a US buyer (854 N. Plymouth, Winamac IN) importing canvas bags from Raghav Home Fashions. Neither is the Indian exporter and neither should be merged into this record. Domestic (India) supply activity is unverified — 'следов поставок по внутреннему рынку не найдено в доступных источниках' rather than a soft 'условно принят'; the company is nonetheless a genuine operating exporter, so it is not rejected.
